name: Revivify

components.m: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a creature that died within the last minute

summary: Bring back a creature that died within the last minute with 1 Hit Point.
text: Touch a creature that died within the last minute; it returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The spell can't revive a creature that died of old age, and it doesn't restore missing body parts.
